content:
António Aguiar Costa – Research, Development and Innovation Director BUILT CoLAB, and Manuel Parente Head of AI BUITL CoLAB, are the Guest Editors of the Special Issue “Decision Support Systems for the Digital Built Environment”, from buildings magazine, part of the section “Construction Management, and Computers & Digitization”, edited by MDPI.

MDPI is a pioneer in open access format publishing in the academic area, supporting academic communities since 1996. This Special Issue aims to bring together new research and development systems with regard to innovative decision support systems for the built environment, strongly supported by recent digital technologies. Your Impact Factor is 2,648 and you have a Citescore of 4.2 on Scopus.

For those interested, the submission of articles is open until December 31, 2021.

See more information here.
